errorRecovery.title: Oops. Something went wrong.
errorRecovery.body: Not quite the feature we had in mind. You can send us a report, or try reloading.
errorRecovery.mailBody: No email has been sent. Review the draft in your email app before sending it.
errorRecovery.mailUnavailable: The email draft couldn’t be opened. Select the report text to copy it and email it to bugs@getsituate.com.
errorRecovery.actionFailed: Recovery couldn’t complete. Your unfinished work remains available. Check the affected operation before trying again.
errorRecovery.reopenBody: Try reloading the workspace first. If Situate still won’t respond, close it from the app switcher and open it again. Copy any unsaved text before closing. Interrupted requests are not repeated automatically.
errorRecovery.repairBlocked: Repair couldn’t start. The assignment below remains in this session only and is not durably saved.
errorRecovery.unavailable: This part of Situate is unavailable.
errorRecovery.subject: Situate: unexpected error
errorRecovery.summary: An unexpected application error occurred. Cause unknown.
errorRecovery.startupFailure: Situate couldn’t finish starting. Review the error to try again or prepare a report.
errorRecovery.fatal: Situate couldn’t display recovery controls. Close and reopen Situate. Unsaved changes may not have been saved.
errorRecovery.repairBody: The error opens in a separate development conversation.
errorRecovery.assignmentSaved: The prepared assignment is saved in the development conversation.
errorRecovery.scopeUnavailable: The affected workspace could not be identified. You can prepare a report or restart Situate.
